svg.text: Audit finding 9 CLOSED on real data: benchmark + multi-sector blind test + independent external validation
All three things the audit said were missing for scientific meaning, now measured. Numbers read from reports/p78, p79, p80.
Honest science: two results are positive, one is a bounded negative. No gate moved; discoveryClaim false.
GAP 1 BENCHMARK
We track the BLS/TCE limit
Re-implemented TCE BLS SNR + >=3-transit / SNR>=7 rule,
DAVE blend FPP, TPM logistic fit to OUR p47 grid.
TCE-accept cells: 74% measured completeness.
TCE-reject cells: 0%.
=> completeness follows the standard BLS/TCE detection
limit on real TESS photometry (8 offline tests).
GAP 2 BLIND TEST
Real per-sector, scaled
24 real hosts (10 injected / 14 null). Not stand-in.
2-sector bar: accepted recall 8/10.
Raw precision 16% -> accepted precision 47%.
But 9 false accepts survive the 2-sector bar.
Honest: cross-sector period corroboration is NECESSARY
but NOT SUFFICIENT (systematics/aliases recur).
GAP 3 VALIDATION
The 0/2 moved off zero
Old 0/2 was STRUCTURAL (P65 audits on an empty catalog,
so an outside claim can never self-corroborate).
New path: BLIND per-sector detection (claim ephemeris
never fed), corroborate across independent sectors,
then confirm an ExoFOP claim. KP controls 9/11;
CP (uncertain EXTERNAL) independently validated 5/9.
HONEST SCOPE
What this is and is not
A CP confirmation is a FIRST independent CHECK that
supports a still-uncertain candidate -- matched to
0.002-0.065% over >=2 sectors -- not a discovery nor a
TRICERATOPS-grade (FPP<1e-3) validation.
Period-only corroboration admits aliases (gap 2's 47%).
Nothing gated/anchored/claimed; discoveryClaim false.
SpaceDataRig/space-data-rig - spacedatarig.app - re-run via npm run p78:blind-multisector / p79:benchmark / p80:external-validation.
